title: Release 2.9 README.md has links to images that do not work on pypi
bug_description: ### 🐛 Describe the bug After deploying PyTorch Release 2.9 I see broken images: Issue is caused by this https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/160416 that pins images to specific commit as suggested by: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/160187#discussion_r2262978006 To fix this we would need to use: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/raw/main/docs/source/_static/img/tensor_illustration.png Rathen then: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/9708fcf92db88b80b9010c68662d634434da3106/docs/source/_static/img/pytorch-logo-dark.png This work fine on https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/ but breaks on pypi cc @svekars @sekyondaMeta @AlannaBurke @malfet @seemethere @albanD ### Versions 2.9.0
error_description: After deploying PyTorch Release 2.9, images in README.md are broken. The issue is caused by PR #160416 which pins images to specific commits. The fix would require using raw GitHub URLs (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/raw/main/docs/source/_static/img/tensor_illustration.png) instead of blob URLs (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/9708fcf92db88b80b9010c68662d634434da3106/docs/source/_static/img/pytorch-logo-dark.png). This works fine on GitHub but breaks on PyPI.
